name: Browser Cloud by TestMu AI
tagline: Give your AI agents real cloud browsers
description: Teaches the agent to use TestMu AI Browser Cloud: real Chrome sessions in the cloud for AI agents, with built-in parallelism, session persistence (cookies, local storage and login state), a tunnel to localhost or staging, and video, network and console logs for every session. The skill writes TypeScript that starts a session and drives it with Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium. Requires a TestMu AI account.

env.name: LT_USERNAME
env.description: Your TestMu AI username. The Browser Cloud SDK reads credentials only from these environment variables.

install.notes: The skill writes TypeScript against the @testmuai/browser-cloud SDK. Set LT_USERNAME and LT_ACCESS_KEY before running the code it generates.
